title: The Password — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning technology
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The password requires a capital letter and a number and a symbol
And at least twelve characters and something that's impossible
To guess — and also something that you'll remember — that's the brief
The password creates the problem it was meant to give relief

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La contraseña requiere una mayúscula y un número y un símbolo
[The password requires a capital letter and a number and a symbol]
Al menos doce caracteres — algo que parece un estímulo
[At least twelve characters — something that seems like a stimulus]
Para olvidar — y también algo que recordarás — eso es el informe
[To forget — and also something you will remember — that is the brief]
La contraseña crea el problema del que se supone que nos conforma
[The password creates the problem it is supposed to solve for us]

[Chorus — English]
The password knows something I don't know
It knows that security is just inconvenience at full flow
The password has to change every ninety days
And every ninety days I start the whole process and the haze
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le mot de passe exige une majuscule, un chiffre et un symbole
[The password requires a capital letter, a number and a symbol]
Au moins douze caractères — quelque chose d'impossible à croire
[At least twelve characters — something impossible to believe]
Et aussi quelque chose que tu te rappelleras — c'est la donnée
[And also something you will remember — that is the given]
Le mot de passe crée le problème qu'il devait éviter
[The password creates the problem it was supposed to avoid]

[Outro — All three languages]
The password knows… La contraseña sabe… Le mot de passe sait
We're all locked out of something — Todos estamos bloqueados — Nous sommes tous bloqués
That's my boy
